Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used both DDA (for spectral library generation) and DIA (for quantification) modes. The primary enrichment was a pull-down (AP-MS) of tagged PD-1. While the study discusses phosphorylation mutants (Y223F, Y248F), these were genetic substitutions to test interaction dependence, not PTM enrichment (like TiO2/IMAC), thus 'mod_phospho' is not applied.

organism: canine osteosarcoma cell lines OSCA8 (cat. EMN001-FP) and OSCA78 (cat. EMN004-FP)
cell_lines: U2OS human osteosarcoma cell line was obtained from Elabscience
Canine osteosarcoma cell lines OSCA8 (cat. EMN001-FP) and OSCA78 (cat. EMN004-FP) were purchased from Kerafast
scope: High-throughput analysis of PD-1 interacting proteins was performed using a pull-down assay and quantitative mass spectrometry proteomic analysis.

The PD-1 interacting proteins were isolated through PD-1 pull-down performed in U2OS cells overexpressing PD-1 protein fused with V5 and Twin-Strep tags. The interacting proteins were purified on StrepTactin magnetic beads and eluted into SDS reducing buffer.
Proteins obtained through pull-down were processed into peptides following a modified filter-aided sample preparation (FASP) protocol

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was specifically performed on material isolated via a pull-down assay using StrepTactin magnetic beads to capture the PD-1 interactome, justifying the 'purified protein or complex' scope. While canine cells were used for validation (PLA/Western Blot), the PRIDE metadata and MS methods focus on the human U2OS model.
